Dana: Micro-challenge: drop one song (<=4min) + one short thing (single ep, short film, or novella under 80 pages). Keep it pocket-sized. I'll start.
Dana: Song — 'Talking Heads - This Must Be the Place (Naive Melody)' (4:00 exact). Short — 'The Lottery' (short story, ~10 min). :books::musical_note:
Miguel: Oooh nice combo. My picks:
Miguel: Song — 'KAYTRANADA - Lite Spots' (3:35). Short — 'The Lunch Date' (short film, ~10 min) perfect for coffee breaks.
Sana: For a mood pivot:
Sana: Song — 'Joni Mitchell - A Case of You' (3:54). Short — 'The Slow Regard of Silent Things' (novella-length but <80 pages if you count certain editions). Cozy and weird. :tea:
Pete: My guilty pleasure:
Pete: Song — 'OutKast - Hey Ya!' (3:55). Short — 'The Office Xmas Special' clip (S2 mini-ep, 20min) good for a laugh in the breakroom. :tada:
Dana: Tiny logistical note: anyone bringing physical books for the swap, label them "swap" and drop on the left side of the lounge shelf before Friday. shelf-bot will auto-archive unlabeled items on Sat.
shelf-bot: Reminder: Drop labeled swap items by Fri 5pm or they'll be moved to free-shelf. Log new items in #ops with photo. :package:
Lena: Quick poll — react :one: if you want a listening hour, :two: for a micro-reading circle, :three: for both. I'll count in two hours.
Miguel: Also made a 10-track microplaylist with everyone's picks so far. Link (placeholder): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3tinyMixExample
Sana: Heads up: if you prefer epub to pdf, I have a tiny script that converts short DRM-free files for offline readers. Ping me and I'll drop it.
Pete: Voting so far: :one: 2 :two: 1 :three: 3 looks like both is winning. Double-feature during Friday's tea?
Dana: Love it. If anyone wants to do a 90-sec intro to why they picked something during the session, sign up here: https://tiny.signup/2min-intros (placeholder).
Lena: Also shoutout to Miguel for curating the playlist — that "Lite Spots" segue is chef's kiss. :clap::sparkles:
Miguel: Thanks! Will add more tiny transitions. If anyone's bringing a USB of local oddities, label format + artist/title so we can credit.
Sana: I'll bring a printed zine of short poems for the free-shelf swap. :bookmark_tabs:
Dana: Perfect. See y'all Friday 3pm. Low-fi, low-pressure. :handshake:
